prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is close, grab it, check properties and perform task. Otherwise, move and scan. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = PerformSpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsRobotCloseToObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Action ID = ScanForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsRobotInCorrectLocation    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsRobotCloseToObject? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO PerformSpecificTask
	END
